title: Built an AI Gladiator Arena for Decision Models (Jev, GPT-Luna-Decision and so on)
author: semibaron
selftext:
Two weeks ago I was at a hackathon and had an idea about the newly released Typesafe.ai Jev decision model. What could we potentially do with it? So I created a little game to test decision models capabilities. 

Here is my **Prototype:** [**Blood & Sand**](https://bloodsand.com) \- a Roman Arena in which each Gladiator (and beast) is controlled by an AI. You as the human just bet your gold , vote,  watch the spectacle and relax :-).

**Current AIs:** 

* TypsafeAI Jev
* GPT-6-Luna-Decision
* Cloudflare Chef
* Perplexity Decider
* LiquidAI d1
* Microsoft-Decision-1
* Nace.AI Drex v2

Over time more Decision models will be added.

It all runs in the browser. Also there is a statistics section for you to check how the different decision models behave. Might be useful for other devs.
